properties.description: tools/test_changelog_fragments.py (hermetic): well-formed fragments pass; an unknown section, stray text, or an entry written straight into [Unreleased] fails; the cut writes the entries under the new version below an empty [Unreleased], grouped in Keep a Changelog order and file-name order, and removes the fragments; a malformed fragment stops the cut with nothing written; two branches adding fragments merge in either order with plain git.
properties.name: CHANGELOG fragments merge in either order, are checked, and the cut assembles and removes them
